entries.note: Kept free of imports so formats.mjs (reader), dashboard.mjs (runtime) and runtime/scripts.mjs (open_script env) can share the same rules without an ES-module cycle: formats.mjs awaits its schema at top level, and a cycle through dashboard.mjs would deadlock module evaluation. The schema lists every kind's fields as optional on one action object because the validator subset has no oneOf/if; these rules add the per-kind required/forbidden fields, unique ids, root-relative paths and UPPER_SNAKE env keys with the offending JSON path in each message.
